note: 全く naturally carries the negative emphasis in cannot possibly, not by any means, and not at all.
演じる means to act a part or play a role, and diễn is a natural Vietnamese verb for that sense.
実際に is a natural adverb meaning actually or in fact for the stated sense.
進む matches spatial advance, but tiến bộ means make progress. Tiến lên means advance/move forward and is attested in the Vietnamese lookup.
事柄 is a standard noun for a matter, circumstance, or affair, matching this stated sense.
また and lại both naturally express again or once more, which is included in the stated sense.
前方 is noun-like; 前方に is the natural adverbial phrase. EN ahead lookup confirms the sense at ent_seq 1394010.
空気 and không khí are the standard terms for physical air or atmosphere, matching the current sense.
一切 is a standard, somewhat emphatic form for all, everything, or entirety and works attributively as 一切の.
ほとんど naturally covers almost, nearly, or mostly, all included in this stated sense.
全部 can function adverbially as entirely and also means the whole or all, matching the sense.
いつも and luôn luôn are standard, neutral ways to say always or all the time.
量 means quantity or amount, and lượng is the natural Vietnamese equivalent for quantity, volume, or capacity.
答える and trả lời are standard verbs meaning to answer or reply, matching this sense.
申し込む covers applying, making an application, proposing marriage, and offering mediation in the stated senses.
近づく is the ordinary verb for approaching, drawing near, or getting close, matching the spatial sense.
大体 is a natural adverb for generally, on the whole, and mostly; JMdict also glosses it approximately (ent_seq 1414470).
協会 and hiệp hội both naturally mean an association, society, or organization, matching this sense.
雰囲気 and bầu không khí are natural equivalents for atmosphere, mood, or ambience.
攻撃 is the standard noun for an attack, assault, raid, or onslaught, matching this sense.
属性 and thuộc tính both naturally mean an attribute or property, matching the noun sense.
自動的 is an adjective, while automatically is an adverb. 自動的に is the standard adverbial form; the base 自動的 is glossed automatic at ent_seq 1318470.
利用可能 is a standard adjective meaning available or usable and fits the stated sense.
赤ちゃん and bé are ordinary, natural words for an infant or baby.
悪い and xấu naturally cover bad, poor, or undesirable.
基本的に is the standard adverb for basically or fundamentally.
以前 naturally means before, prior to, or ago as an adverb, matching the sense.
行動 is the standard noun for action, conduct, or behavior; the core meaning matches this item.
黒い and đen directly mean black and are natural neutral color adjectives.
青い and xanh dương are standard terms for blue or azure.
体 and cơ thể are standard neutral nouns for the human body.
迷惑 is a natural noun for trouble, bother, or annoyance, matching the stated sense.
少年 and cậu bé are standard words for a boy or male child.
明るい and sáng are natural neutral adjectives for a bright color.
持ってくる is an everyday verb for bringing or fetching something; mang is a natural equivalent.
The stated sense is siblings; 兄弟 and anh em are standard generic terms, though they do not encode the sibling's age.
建てる is the standard verb for building or constructing, matching the current verb sense.
買う and mua are standard verbs for purchasing or buying.
落ち着いた and bình tĩnh emphasize composure; the sense also stresses relaxed/easygoing. EN calm gives ゆったり with calm, easy, relaxed at ent_seq 2010000; thoải mái is attested.
容量 is the standard noun for capacity or volume and matches the stated sense.
